sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS We will not receive any proceeds from the sale
of the Private Placement Shares by the Selling Stockholders. We will, however, receive up to an aggregate of approximately $9.4 million
in cash from the exercise of the Second Warrants, assuming the exercise in full for cash of all the Second Warrants, which we intend
to use for working capital and general corporate purposes. The Selling Stockholders will receive all of
the proceeds of the sale of Private Placement Shares offered from time to time pursuant to this prospectus. Accordingly, we will not
receive any proceeds from the sale of the Private Placement Shares that may be sold from time to time pursuant to this prospectus. See
